title: Library
intro: Texts for wider reading on Billy Budd: the editions, Melville’s sources and naval history, the Somers affair, his reading, and the criticism. Texts in the public domain are held here; the rest link to where they are published. Each entry says under what licence.

items.title: An essay on the legality of impressing seamen
items.author: Butler, Charles
items.note: Anonymous essay on the legal basis of impressing seamen into the navy, catalogued as "[by C. Butler]". Its subject is the law under which Billy is taken from the merchantman Rights-of-Man. Oxford University copy digitised by Google.
